title: Woman Gives Birth in Police Station Driveway
summary: A woman gave birth in the driveway of a Queensland police station. Officers were alerted when a man flagged them down as they were returning to the station. The woman received assistance during the birth.
summary_points: A woman gave birth in the driveway of a Queensland police station.
Officers were flagged down by a man in the driveway.
The birth occurred as officers were returning to the station.
The woman received help during the delivery.
title_hi: महिला ने पुलिस स्टेशन के ड्राइववे में बच्चे को जन्म दिया
summary_hi: एक महिला ने क्वींसलैंड पुलिस स्टेशन के ड्राइववे में बच्चे को जन्म दिया। जब अधिकारी स्टेशन लौट रहे थे तो एक व्यक्ति ने उन्हें ड्राइववे में रोका। महिला को जन्म के दौरान सहायता मिली।
summary_points_hi: एक महिला ने क्वींसलैंड पुलिस स्टेशन के ड्राइववे में बच्चे को जन्म दिया।
अधिकारियों को एक व्यक्ति ने ड्राइववे में रोका।
जन्म तब हुआ जब अधिकारी स्टेशन लौट रहे थे।
महिला को प्रसव के दौरान मदद मिली।

sources.headline: Baby girl born in driveway of Queensland police station
